About Us :

 Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the  DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.

 Overview: 

 DV is looking for an experienced software developer to work with a small team responsible for development and daily operations of back-office systems that provide services to traders, risk management and accounting.

 Job Responsibilities: 

 
 Work alongside other software engineers, risk management, accounting and traders to provide real-time and batch processing of data.

 Generate daily reports for the firm and traders from overnight data.

 Design and use of database schemas to facilitate processing of data.

 Monitoring of daily jobs to ensure timely dissemination of vital information.

 Ensuring the flow of real-time trade data to provide accurate intraday position and trade data to risk management and traders.

 
 Requirements: 

 
 
 Python at a senior professional level: typing, packaging, concurrency, profiling, and performance tuning



 
 Production ownership of scheduled and batch data systems with hard deadlines (start-of-day and end-of-day processing), including retries, idempotency, alerting, and recovery



 
 Strong SQL and PostgreSQL experience: schema design, migrations, query tuning, data integrity controls



 
 Workflow orchestration experience (Airflow or equivalent) and CI/CD pipelines



 
 Demonstrated quality discipline: automated testing, code review, incident response, runbooks, and post-incident follow-through



 
 Fluency with Atlassian tooling (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) as a daily working environment



 
 Practical experience applying AI: LLM APIs for automation or analysis, and thoughtful use of AI coding assistants with human review



 
 Clear written and verbal communication with non-engineers: operations, accounting, settlements, and middle office staff



 
 Ability to mentor junior and mid-level developers and make sound design decisions independently



 
 Nice to Have: 

 
 
 Trade lifecycle domain knowledge for futures and options: trade capture, allocations, give-ups, clearing, settlements, reconciliation, commissions and fees, margin, PnL



 
 Experience with trading and position platforms (TPOS or similar), broker and clearer file formats, SFTP, and FIX/drop-copy ingestion



 
 Reconciliation and data quality frameworks, and building audit trails



 
 Experience moving legacy jobs and servers onto a cleaner architecture without breaking daily operations



 
 DevOps and SRE foundation: Docker, infrastructure as code, observability (Prometheus, Grafana, structured logging)



 
 On-prem and bare metal infrastructure exposure alongside cloud



 
 Agent patterns: tools, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review



 
 Light front-end skills (internal tools and dashboards)



 
 Benefits: 

 
 Discretionary bonus eligibility

 Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care Options

 Employer Paid Group Term Life and AD&D insurance

 Voluntary LTD, Life & AD&D insurance

 Flexible Vacation policy

 Retirement plan with employer match

 
 DV is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. Only search firms with valid, written agreements with DV should submit resumes in response to DV ’s posted positions. All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV , and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV . DV is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus (at DV Trading's discretion) and DV Trading's benefits package, including the benefits listed above.
